An '''anti-Republic force''' fought against [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Eeth Koth/Legends|Eeth Koth]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] in [[Battle of Korriban (Clone Wars)|battle]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]<ref name="Wild Space" /> in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]'' to [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].</ref>
